{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1
filtered_df = sales_df[ sales_df['customer_age'] != -1 ]

# Compute the mean age of remaining customers
mean_age = filtered_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Confirm the count
count_after_filter = len(filtered_df)

mean_age, count_after_filter"}
